Daily Devotional

September 17

2 For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it. (Hebrews 4:2 KJV)

This is talking about the Jew’s that were brought out of Egypt by God working all the miracles through Moses. They were not told about Jesus being the Lamb of God that would save them. But they were shown by example when they took the sacrificed lambs and put the blood on their door posts, and the angel of the Lord passed over them and smote all the first born of the Egyptians. This was a picture, or shadow, of Jesus coming and being our sacrificial lamb to save us by His blood. The Jew’s were not saved from the Egyptians because they deserved it, as we are not saved because we deserve it, but because God is love (1 John 4:8), He has saved us by Grace.

The Word of God being preached will not save anyone, unless they are being drawn by the Holy Spirit, as Jesus said no one comes to Him unless the Father draws them (John 6:44). Hearing the Word is a requirement to be saved, but you must be able to receive it with faith before you will be saved. God’s Word does not change, and is just the same today as it was in the beginning (Matthew 24:35). People that say it is outdated and no longer relevant to us today are totally wrong. Jesus, the same yesterday, today and forever – Thank God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
